surface_mechanism_description: Surface deformation due to ductile layering/smearing with no evidence of brittle fracture. Wear reduction in the quaternary Zn(Ti,Zr)O3 coating was a result of a tribo ﬁlm/mechanically mixed layer, composed of amorphous transferred silica from the sliding Si3N4 counterface and re ﬁned nanocrystalline Zn(Ti,Zr)O3 grains from the coating. The wear mechanism responsible for wear reduction of the quaternary oxide is an interfacial sliding velocity accommodation mode between the ball and tribo ﬁlm (mechanically mixed layer) composed of the re ﬁned coating and transferred ball material.
